instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with a piece of parchment paper cut to fit the bottom and sides of the dish; set aside.
Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, cut butter and unsweetened chocolate into small pieces. Place in a large heatproof bowl along with the chocolate chips.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup butter, unsalted
1 (4 oz) bar 100% unsweetened chocolate
8 oz extra dark chocolate chips (60-65%)

instructions.primary_message: Once simmering, uncover the pot and place the bowl with the butter and chocolate over the simmering water, allowing it to sit on the rim. Using a silicone spatula, stir often, until completely melted.

Add sugar, vanilla, and salt to the bowl with the melted chocolate mixture. Stir the mixture continuously (over the simmering water) until sugar begins to dissolve. Once dissolved, remove bowl from the heat, placing it on top of a dish towel on the countertop (this will help keep the bowl from sliding around).
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups granulated sugar
1 tsp vanilla extract
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add eggs, one at a time, whisking very well after each addition. Once all of the eggs have been added, the brownie batter should look smooth and glossy (if it looks grainy or broken, keep whisking).
Using a strainer, sift flour into the bowl with the batter. Whisk until just incorporated.
Pour batter into the prepared baking dish, spreading it out in an even layer.

Place baking dish in the oven and bake until brownies are just set, 22-25 minutes (when the brownies are done, the center may still appear slightly underbaked; it will firm up once cool). Remove from oven and let cool.
Once the brownies have cooled completely, remove from the baking dish, cut into squares, and arrange on a platter. Enjoy!
